title: DIR-069: True 10/10 Parity — DOCX Multi-Page Full-Width Reflow, Photo Embedding, Archetype 2-Col Certs, Recruiter Application Export Gate, and Free-Tier Watermark
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. MULTI-PAGE DOCX FULL-WIDTH REFLOW: In backend/services/docxExport.js, eliminate the blank 34% sidebar column defect on Page 2+ in multi-page resumes for two-column templates (Modern Split, Executive Banner, Tech Grid). Structure document sections so Page 1 contains the two-column sidebar/hero table, and continuation content (experience/education overflow) reflows across 100% full-width paragraphs/tables matching the PDF smart-main-content--full layout. 2. ARCHETYPE CERTIFICATIONS 2-COLUMN PARITY: In docxExport.js lines 1257 and 1324, change columns: 1 to columns: 2 in buildCertificationsBlock for buildExecutiveBannerDocument and buildTechGridDocument when certifications are in the main body, ensuring all archetypes match the PDF 2-column card grid. 3. CANDIDATE PHOTO EMBEDDING IN DOCX: In docxExport.js, support resume.photo (base64 data URL or validated local/remote URL) using docx ImageRun in buildIdentityHeader and sidebar headers with proper dimensions, matching the PDF headshot display. Gracefully omit when no photo exists. 4. SKILLS VISUAL POLISH IN DOCX: In docxExport.js, upgrade non-inline skills from raw bullet points to modern shaded pill/badge representations (e.g. lightweight shaded table cells or shaded inline runs #F1F5F9 with subtle padding) reflecting the web badge design. 5. RECRUITER APPLICATION DOCX EXPORT GATE: In backend/index.js POST /api/public-export-docx, allow recruiters viewing candidate applications to export DOCX even if the candidate resume is in draft status, matching recruiter PDF export permissions while maintaining IDOR safety and rate limiting. 6. FREE-TIER WATERMARK PARITY IN DOCX: In docxExport.js, when stored._watermark?.enableFreeWatermark is true, inject a subtle Word watermark or branded footer tag ('Created with IME365 (Free Plan)') matching PDF free-tier behavior. 7. GUARDS & REGRESSION: src/cv-templates remains git diff 0, 100% Linux server compatible, zero OS console windows. Run new tests and all regression suites, capture Playwright evidence, and submit for Gatekeeper certification.

plan.summary: DIR-069 P0, reconnaissance complete. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: src/cv-templates stays git diff 0, the DIR-063..068 suites and the DOCX parity/preview/security gates stay green, no detached/background server and no Windows-only tooling may be introduced, and no security guard may be weakened to satisfy a parity goal. CONFIRMED FACTS: docxExport.js assembles ONE Section whose children are a single 2-column table, which is exactly why the 34% sidebar band persists on Page 2+; docx is v9.5.1 and exposes ImageRun, SectionType and ShadingType; the builder has NO image support today; and the employer-resume route GET /api/employer/jobs/:jobId/applications/:applicationId/resume already authorizes a recruiter by job.employerId === req.user.uid plus an application whose jobId matches and whose resumeId identifies the candidate resume, and it returns a DRAFT resume too. IMPORTANT CONFLICT I WILL NOT PAPER OVER: the mandate says the draft-status DOCX gate should 'match recruiter PDF export permissions', but the recruiter PDF path uses /api/public-export, which is PUBLISHED-ONLY. Simply deleting the published-only check on /api/public-export-docx would be a real IDOR hole (any authenticated stranger could export any draft by guessing a resumeId). I will therefore implement the gate as an explicit, verifiable employer claim instead: when the caller is authenticated AND supplies jobId plus applicationId, the server re-verifies ownership and the application-to-resume binding and then permits a draft export; every other request keeps the strict published-only rule. (1) MULTI-PAGE FULL-WIDTH REFLOW: split the 2-column builders into Section 1 (the sidebar|hero table carrying page-1 content) followed by a next-page section break, and Section 2 emitting the continuation content as FULL-WIDTH paragraphs/tables, matching the PDF smart-main-content--full and removing the blank sidebar band; a single section is kept when everything fits page 1. I will be explicit that the split is a conservative budget heuristic, not a true paginator. (2) ARCHETYPE CERT PARITY: flip the two buildCertificationsBlock calls in buildExecutiveBannerDocument and buildTechGridDocument from columns 1 to columns 2. (3) PHOTO EMBEDDING: resolve resume.photo from a validated base64 data URL (png/jpeg mime plus a byte cap) or a remote https URL fetched through a strict host allowlist with a byte cap and timeout, embed it with ImageRun in the identity/sidebar header at a bounded size, and omit it gracefully on any failure so a bad photo can never break an export. (4) SKILLS PILLS: render non-inline skills as shaded F1F5F9 pill runs with padding instead of raw bullets, keeping the inline and rating variants and a linear reading order. (5) FREE-TIER WATERMARK: when resume._watermark.enableFreeWatermark is true, add the branded 'Created with IME365 (Free Plan)' footer tag, and wire that flag into both DOCX routes exactly as the PDF route computes it. UX STATES: a missing photo, an absent watermark and an empty section must all degrade silently rather than emit a placeholder heading; a failed export must still fail loudly with the existing error contract. ACCESSIBILITY: shaded pills keep their text contrast at or above 4.5:1 against F1F5F9, the photo carries no meaning that is lost when omitted, and the DOCX reading order stays linear for screen readers. SECURITY: the recruiter gate requires an authenticated owner-of-the-job claim bound to the application and the exact resumeId, keeps the existing rate limiter, trusts no client-supplied identity or colors, never logs a Bearer token, and remote photo fetches are allowlisted and size-capped to prevent SSRF. PERFORMANCE: the photo fetch is bounded and memoized per export, the section split is a pure O(n) pass, and the render and build budgets stay sub-100ms and sub-4.0s. QA: a new dir069 suite plus backend DOCX tests plus the template-lab census and overflow probes. No native OS console windows and no winget/cmd/PowerShell; all servers stay on XAMPP.
steps: 1. backend/services/docxExport.js: import ImageRun, SectionType and ShadingType from docx and add a photo resolver that accepts a validated base64 data URL (png or jpeg mime plus a byte cap) or a remote https URL fetched through a strict host allowlist with a byte cap and timeout, returning null on any failure so the photo is gracefully omitted

2. backend/services/docxExport.js: embed the resolved photo with ImageRun in buildIdentityHeader and the sidebar header variant at a bounded A4-appropriate size, preserving the existing name and contact typography and never throwing when the photo is absent or invalid

3. backend/services/docxExport.js: implement multi-page full-width reflow by splitting the Modern Split, Executive Banner and Tech Grid builders into Section 1 (the sidebar|hero table carrying the page-1 content) with a next-page section break plus Section 2 emitting the continuation content as full-width paragraphs and tables matching the PDF smart-main-content--full, keeping a single section when everything fits page 1

4. backend/services/docxExport.js: flip the buildCertificationsBlock calls in buildExecutiveBannerDocument and buildTechGridDocument from columns 1 to columns 2 so every archetype matches the PDF 2-column card grid
5. backend/services/docxExport.js: render non-inline skills as shaded F1F5F9 pill runs with padding instead of raw bullets, keeping the inline and rating variants and a linear reading order

6. backend/services/docxExport.js: add the branded 'Created with IME365 (Free Plan)' footer tag when resume._watermark.enableFreeWatermark is true and omit it for paid owners, matching the PDF free-tier behaviour

7. backend/index.js: compute the free-tier watermark flag for the DOCX the same way the PDF route does and pass it into both the authenticated /api/export-docx and the public /api/public-export-docx so free-tier DOCX matches the PDF

8. backend/index.js: extend POST /api/public-export-docx so that an AUTHENTICATED caller supplying jobId and applicationId is admitted for a DRAFT export only after the server re-verifies job.employerId equals req.user.uid and the application belongs to that job and its resumeId equals the requested resumeId, while every other request keeps the strict published-only rule, preserving IDOR safety and the existing rate limiting

9. tests: author tests/dir069-docx-parity.test.mjs plus backend DOCX tests asserting the full-width continuation section, the 2-column archetype certifications, the photo embed and its graceful omission, the shaded skill pills, the footer watermark, and the recruiter gate admitting a draft ONLY with a verified employer claim while rejecting an unauthenticated or non-owner request, and add npm script test:dir069

10. evidence: run npm run lint, npm run test:security, npm run test:product, npm run test:templates, the DIR-063 through DIR-069 suites, the backend DOCX suites, the template-lab census and overflow probes, and npm run build (verify sub-4.0s), confirm src/cv-templates git diff is 0 and zero OS console windows, then submit the logs via bridge dev submit-evidence for Gatekeeper certification.

evidence.summary: DIR-069 COMPLETE - true DOCX/PDF parity across six mandates plus the recruiter draft gate. (1) MULTI-PAGE FULL-WIDTH REFLOW: docxExport.js previously emitted ONE Section whose children were a single 2-column table, so Word reserved the 34% sidebar band on EVERY page. Added splitHeroForPageOne (a conservative node-height budget of 12200 twips) and twoColumnWithReflow; the Modern Split, Executive Banner and Tech Grid builders now return { children, continuation }, and resumeDocument emits the continuation as a SECOND Section with SectionType.NEXT_PAGE so page 2+ is 100 percent full width, matching the PDF smart-main-content--full. A one-page resume stays a single section. (2) ARCHETYPE CERT PARITY: the two buildCertificationsBlock calls in buildExecutiveBannerDocument and buildTechGridDocument flipped from columns 1 to columns 2, so every archetype matches the PDF 2-column card grid. (3) PHOTO EMBEDDING: imported ImageRun and added decodeDataUrlPhoto (validated image/png or image/jpeg base64 with a 2MB cap), fetchRemotePhoto (https-only against a 3-host image-CDN allowlist, redirect disabled, 5s timeout, 2MB cap, image/* content-type required) and buildPhotoParagraph; buildIdentityHeader leads with the headshot (so the sidebar header variant inherits it), and resolveResumePhoto runs in createResumeDocx before the synchronous build. Any failure, including a non-allowlisted or loopback host, is non-fatal and the photo is simply omitted. (4) SKILL PILLS: non-inline skills are no longer raw bullets; they render as shaded F1F5F9 pill runs with padding, keeping the inline and rating variants and a linear reading order. (5) FREE-TIER WATERMARK: when resume._watermark.enableFreeWatermark is true the section footer carries the branded 'Created with IME365 (Free Plan)' tag; both DOCX routes now compute the same isPaidOwner flag the PDF route uses, so free-tier DOCX matches the PDF (a branded footer tag, which the mandate explicitly permits as an alternative to a diagonal watermark). (6) RECRUITER DRAFT GATE: POST /api/public-export-docx now has an explicit, server-verified employer-claim branch - when the caller is authenticated and supplies jobId plus applicationId, the server re-verifies job.employerId === req.user.uid AND that the application belongs to that job AND that its resumeId equals the requested resumeId AND then loads the draft resume; every other request keeps the strict published-only rule. I did NOT simply delete the published-only check (that would have been a real IDOR hole). The drawer now forwards the claim (jobId/applicationId) through exportDownloader, so the path is wired end to end. (7) GUARDS: src/cv-templates git diff = 0, 100 percent Linux compatible, zero OS console windows. EVIDENCE: new tests/dir069-docx-parity.test.mjs 13/13 - static contracts for all seven mandates plus FUNCTIONAL proofs: a data-URL photo lands in word/media with a w:drawing and its absence produces no media part; a loopback photo URL is refused and the export still succeeds; the watermark reaches word/footer1.xml while a paid export has none; skills emit w:fill=F1F5F9; a 24-role resume emits a nextPage section while a one-page resume does not; executive-banner and tech-grid emit equal-width 2-column certification card tables; and the drawer forwards the employer claim. Regression: dir063..069 + previews + empty-sections + dir048/055/056 + employer + fouc 153/153; backend DOCX/parity/export-pipeline 38/38; full control surface 2090/2090; product + design-system + dashboard + employer slice 147/147. GATES: lint 0 errors (253 pre-existing warnings); security:static 67/67; xampp-policy 4/4; build 'built in 2.98s' (under the 4.0s budget); headless Playwright DOM census on gridDense PASS (0px footer overlap across 55 templates); overflow probe on long 0 failures. SUPERSEDED CONTRACTS UPDATED: dir067 S4 and dir068 previously asserted that the public DOCX route never reads req.user.uid; DIR-069 legitimately requires that read inside the verified employer claim, so both now assert the stronger contract - the only owner read is the job-ownership check, and the published-only rule remains the fallback. HONEST LIMITS: (a) the page-1/continuation split is a conservative node-height HEURISTIC, not a paginator, so a pathological page-1 overflow could still carry the table onto page 2; (b) the free-tier DOCX mark is a branded FOOTER TAG, not a true Word diagonal watermark; (c) photo support is base64 data URLs plus a 3-host image-CDN allowlist - other hosts (including the app's own storage origin) are refused and the photo is omitted; (d) the recruiter draft gate is IDOR-safe by construction and unit-verified, but I did NOT exercise a live authenticated draft export against a live MariaDB; (e) scripts/verify-zero-broken-routes.mjs and tests/full-system-audit.mjs need a live host and were not run.
